name: ImGui Contract Drawing
description: The validation contract's drawing fixture: one 720x480 window that draws one row's geometry at a time (lines, rectangles, circles, text, an image, polygons, a clip, an alpha wash, a kept draw list, refused handles and printed handles), driven by its Probe Actions window or the probe_run tool.

tools.name: probe_run
tools.description: Draws one screen by name, the same screens its Probe Actions window's buttons select; `off_frame` runs the off-frame attempts.

action.description: The screen's name, as README.md lists it.

tools.name: probe_status
tools.description: Which screen is drawn, how many frames it has drawn, and the last refusal.
